The degreaser is intended for use in removing grease and
dirt from parts associated with maintenance shop operations.

                                                                    6    TANK SHELVES.

                                                                    Two shelves (3) are supplied with the unit and rest in the
                                                                    bottom of the cleaning portion of the cabinet, just above the
                                                                    soak tank. The shelves are removable from the tank. The
                                                                    shelves are designed to support 300 pounds of parts. Also
                                                                    supplied with the unit are two parts baskets (1) and a remov-
                                                                    able drying shelf (2). The parts baskets have lifting handles
                                                                    on each end so that when resting in the soak tank, the lifting
                                                                    handles will extend above the solution level. The removable
                                                                    drying shelf attaches to the side of the degreaser and is ca-
                                                                    pable of holding the parts basket when fully loaded. Since
                                                                    the tank cover can be closed when the drying shelf is at-
                                                                    tached, one parts basket can be in the tank being cleaned or
                                                                    soaked while the other parts basket rests on the drying shelf
                                                                    preparatory to the next operation.
